t: Introduction and overview — Invincible-class Aircraft Carrier
name: Introduction and overview — Invincible-class Aircraft Carrier — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Invincible-class Aircraft Carrier
description: Introduction and overview of the Invincible-class Aircraft Carrier: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Royal Navy's Invincible class — three ships — were 'through-deck cruisers' built for Sea Harriers and anti-submarine helicopters. HMS Invincible and HMS Hermes served in the Falklands War, where Sea Harriers proved decisive. The class pioneered the ski-jump STOVL carrier. Baseline facts: Royal Navy STOVL carrier; 3 built; Sea Harriers; Falklands War service..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
